messages:
marta: Quick heads-up — planning a gradual rollout for runtime v3.2.1 on the inference fleet. Target plan: 5% -> 25% -> 60% over 60m/30m/30m buckets starting 2026-03-18 08:00 PT. Will route by cohorts (low-latency geo first). Need: smoke owner, rollback ready, and who will watch latency/QA dashboards.

sam: I can be the smoke owner for the 08:00 window. Will start 07:50 to validate preflight. please ping me @sam when you trigger.

marta: Thanks — noted. Exact start unix: `1710739200` (08:00 PT). Plan to trigger 5% at start, +20% at +60m, +35% at +90m if metrics look good.

oliver: Which clusters will receive the initial 5%? We should avoid sending to the experimental bucket. Also confirm model variant pinning — are we serving v3.2.1 quantized or fallback to v3.1 if any errors?

marta: Initial cohorts: us-west-prod-a (50%) + eu-west-prod-b (50%) for the 5% sample. No experimental. We will pin quantized v3.2.1; fallback policy: auto-fallback -> v3.1 (stable) after 3xx/5xx rate > 0.5% or token-latency p95 > 2.5s for 5m.

lee: Smoke checklist I'll run:
- run `kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/rt-service` on both clusters
- curl `https://health.redwood/api/v1/ready` x50
- run sample harness: `python infra/tests/smoke_harness.py --profile canary`
If anything fails, I will trigger rollback via `redwood-deploy rollback --to v3.1 --reason "smoke-fail"` and @marta will coordinate communications.

marta: Perfect. Add one more: monitor cost/throughput anomaly in the console for first 30m. If token cost deviance > 15% abort.

sam: Can we add a short live runbook in the thread for the on-call? Something like:
```
1) At t0 trigger 5% (deploy-bot will post event)
2) Wait 5m, check p95 latency and error rate
3) If OK, schedule +20% at t0+60m
4) If any threshold breached -> rollback and notify #incidents
```

marta: Yep — that's the plan. I'll paste the thresholds here: error_rate_fail = 0.5%, p95_latency_fail = 2500ms, cost_dev_fail = 15%.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout job created: job_id=rollout-2358881024, start=1710739200, steps=[5,25,60], watchlist=[latency,p99,error_rate,cost].

oliver: One ask — when you ramp to 25% can we exclude customers in the enterprise cohort (cust tags: enterprise=true) for extra safety? If yes, we need routing filter applied before step 2.

marta: Good call. Yes, exclude enterprise=true for all canary cohorts until full rollout. I'll add routing rule `route.filter != enterprise:true` for the canary slice.

lee: I'll be on Slack for the whole window. I can do immediate rollback if smoke harness fails.

sam: I'll watch dashboards and be ready to escalate. :thumbsup:

marta: Thanks team. Final: I'll trigger the scheduled job at 07:58 to sanity-check, then kick at 08:00. Posting logs to #eng-releases when steps complete.
